metaTitle: Charge a Power Station From Your Car
description: Step-by-step guide to charging a portable power station from a car 12V socket, with real charging times, faster options and ways to protect your battery.
directAnswer: Plug the station's 12V car cable into the accessory socket with the engine running. Expect only 60 to 120 W, so a 500 Wh unit needs about five to six hours of driving, and never charge with the engine off.
